# boomi_data_integration_river_variables (Resource)

Manages the full set of variables for a single river. Uses replace-all semantics: variables not listed in this resource are deleted. Encrypted variable values are written as plaintext and stored as the stable API-returned ciphertext in state; drift detection works because the ciphertext only changes when a new plaintext is written. Multi-value variable values are stored as a JSON array string.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `river_id` (String) Cross-ID of the river whose variables this resource manages. Changing it forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `environment_id` (String) Environment the river belongs to. Falls back to the provider-level environment_id.
- `variable` (Block List) A river variable. Order is preserved as returned by the API. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--variable))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource ID. Equals <environment_id>/<river_id>.

<a id="nestedblock--variable"></a>
### Nested Schema for `variable`

Required:

- `name` (String) Variable name.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Variable value. For multi-value variables, provide a JSON array string (e.g. '[1,2]'). For encrypted variables, provide the plaintext — the API encrypts it and stores the ciphertext.

Optional:

- `clear_value_on_start` (Boolean) Whether the runtime clears this variable's value at the start of each run.
- `is_encrypted` (Boolean) Whether the value is encrypted at rest. Provide plaintext on write; state stores ciphertext.
- `is_multi_value` (Boolean) Whether this variable holds multiple values (array).
